newsitem.title: USA: Fleet gives Joan Fabrics $450 mln in finance.
newsitem.headline: Fleet gives Joan Fabrics $450 mln in finance.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group said Friday it has provided $425 million in financing to Lowell, Mass.-based Joan Fabrics Corp, to be used in connection with its acquisition of North Carolina-based Mastercraft Group.
The acquisition will create a textile manufacturing firms with more than $500 million in sales.
The credit facility, structured and fully underwritten by Fleet as administrative agent, consists of three term loans and a revolving credit facility.

Goldman Sachs Credit Partners LP and Wachovia Bank NA have committed as documentation agents to the transaction, which will be syndicated among a group of financial institutions. In addition to financing the $310 million acquisition of Mastercraft, the credit facility will be used to refinance Joan Fabrics' existing debt and for working capital purposes.
